manifest.test_set_note: One exact-source-renderer replication: eight fresh complete pairs in the original four paired context classes, four surface absences and four inventory erasures. Only the declared object identifiers, immutable receipt identifiers and dates are instantiated afresh; all wording, punctuation, context-resolved English epochs and full as_of rendering are preserved. The replacement table was fixed before token encoding; no selection by count. Fictional text reports, not verification of actual deletion. This tests lexical-instance sensitivity within this small renderer, not eight new semantic designs, the full 160-scenario claim, comprehension or a future tokenizer. The abandoned free-prose preparation was never minted or counted. Preserve every outcome; no rerun to seek agreement. Aggregate-only source: no new settlement strata.
